verdict.rationale: Langfuse is a platform rather than an agent, so publishing an MCP server is a fair axis. Its API and data platform overview lists an official "MCP Server" for connecting AI tools that cannot run shell commands, and a separate Docs MCP server is documented so Cursor or other coding agents can integrate Langfuse tracing. The evidence is only short overview-table lines, so the depth of what an agent can actually do is unclear. Missing for 10: details on which tools/operations the platform MCP server exposes, setup and auth documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connectivity.
